# List workspace directory (workspace.list)

## categories

[
  "workspace",
  "files"
]

## demonstrations

[
  {
    "expected_output": {
      "entries": []
    },
    "id": "basic",
    "input": {},
    "title": "Basic invocation in an empty workspace"
  }
]

## description

Lists immediate children sorted by relative path. The default path is the workspace root, expressed as a dot. Returns paths and kinds, without reading file contents. Hidden files are included.

[
  {

  }
